character_sheet: A hovering ghost of the Halloween nights: one 6x21x6 head-and-body column and two 2x11x2 arms splayed 0.33 rad (19 deg) at the shoulders (GhostModel.java:38-49), drawn translucent (GhostRenderer.java:38-40). It passes through blocks (noPhysics, Ghost.java:50) and drifts toward a spot beside the nearest player within 16 blocks, else to a random air pocket (Ghost.java:119-160), and hurts whoever it touches: 2 contact damage within 1.5 blocks every 20 ticks, no melee goal (Ghost.java:102-116, doHurtTarget :68-71). It spawns at night, in Halloween week anywhere and year-round in snowy taiga, taiga, frozen river, jungle and dark forest (Ghost.java:196-209). Read it as a sheet ghost: a still column, two arms drifting slowly and never quite together.
size_notes: Drawn at x0.65 of the rig (GhostRenderer.java:21, 45) on a 64x64 sheet (GhostModel.java:50); the hitbox is 0.5 x 1.5 (ModEntities.java:638-639); no shadow (SHADOW 0, GhostRenderer.java:19).

behaviour: Four slow cosines on the two arms and nothing else (GhostModel.java:56-59): the left arm rolls about z at 0.30 rad/tick around a -0.33 rad (19 deg) splay and the right at 0.32 around +0.33; the left arm swings about x at 0.34 around -0.33 and the right at 0.36 around +0.33 - each pi x 0.05 = 9 deg either way.

The four rates are deliberately unequal (periods 20.9, 19.6, 18.5 and 17.5 ticks), so the arms drift in and out of step over the minutes rather than waving in unison; the head-and-body column is static - no line of setupAnim touches it.

Nothing scales with walking speed (limbSwingAmount is unused, GhostModel.java:54) and nothing turns toward the player (netHeadYaw and headPitch are unused) even though a LookAtPlayerGoal runs (Ghost.java:55).

The visible travel is the entity's own drift, not a pose: customServerAiStep eases the motion toward a flight target beside the nearest player or a random air pocket (Ghost.java:119-160), turns the yaw a sixth of the way per tick (:162-165) and damps the vertical motion to 0.65 each tick (:76-78); it hovers with noPhysics (:50) and never takes fall damage (:186-188).
Drawn translucent through entityTranslucent (GhostRenderer.java:38-40) at x0.65 (GhostRenderer.java:45).
